description: Appendix D.2 ladder-concatenation task (claim C3): GCN with Ising ground-state correlation eigenvectors against GCN with Laplacian eigenvectors, GatedGCN with RRWP edges and GCN without encoding, four seeds each, the paper's 200 epochs. Amended 2026-11-08 before launch (user decision): added the top-3 eigenvector control synthetic_quantum_top3, so 20 runs.
split: test (10% of the 800 generated graphs, split seed 1729)
checkpoint_rule: model with the highest validation accuracy over the 200 epochs, evaluated once on the test split
aggregation: mean and sample standard deviation over the four seeds
tie_rule: no winner unless the margin exceeds twice the larger seed standard deviation and an exact McNemar test on the pooled test predictions gives p < 0.05
selection_rule: none: this sweep compares fixed configurations, no candidate is selected
